subtitle: Sort and flip pancake stacks
description:
Griddlewise is a sorting puzzle about pancakes. Every plate on the griddle holds a mixed stack of flavours: buttermilk, strawberry, matcha, blueberry, cocoa, red velvet and ube. Tap a stack, then tap another plate to move the top pancakes onto an empty plate or onto a matching flavour. Make every plate a single flavour and the stack is served with butter and syrup.

The twist is the spatula. Swipe up on any pancake and you flip it and everything above it in one move, turning that part of the stack upside down. A buried pancake can come to the top in one flip, but everything above it turns over with it. Plan your flips and one good flip can line up a whole run.

It's the breakfast rush, so you play against the clock: a pat of butter that slowly melts. Serving stacks and clearing griddles adds time, and every flip costs a second. Each new griddle brings more flavours, taller stacks and less room to work. Chain quick serves for combo points, clear griddles with only a few flips for a bonus, and beat your best score.

Every flavour has its own colour and its own pattern, so you can play without telling colours apart.

Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
